RULED YES, it must. A retrieval score is a function of the embedding model, so the embedding binding is the thing whose change invalidates the score; pinning a generation-model fingerprint would make baselines incomparable across an embedding swap while still LOOKING comparable. That is the same poisoning ES-11's ruling forbids when it refuses an invented fingerprint. Narrow the pin to the embedding binding for retrieval subjects and say so at the read surface.
